attrs.reason: Gross margin improved 80 bps (E35). The MD&A attributes this to a ~60 bps sales mix benefit from reduced outlet excess-inventory sales and lower wholesale footwear proportion (E36), and a ~50 bps benefit from lower input costs (E37). The DTC revenue growth of $176.8M (E34) is visible in the numbers and supports a mix shift toward higher-margin channels. The aggregate COGS growth (25.1%) lagging revenue growth (27.1%) is consistent with lower input costs or favorable mix. While the input cost benefit is not directly isolated, the overall margin expansion is consistent with the cited drivers at the stated scale.

rebuttal.innocent_explanation: The 80 bps gross margin improvement (47.9%→48.7%, E35) is corroborated by the 33.2% DTC revenue growth ($176.8M, E34) shifting mix toward higher-margin channels (E36) and management's stated 50 bps input cost benefit (E37). The DTC mix shift is visible in the numbers at a scale consistent with the claimed 60 bps mix benefit, and the margin expansion supports faster cash conversion from DTC sales.

attrs.final_verdict: explanation does not fit the numbers
